title: Window 3: devoff2 (ref) vs baseline, devoff2 + Agent 11 ON bundle, native2 N0 (and devoff2 + Agent 12 ON bundle if it fits). Uncapped, title loop, no input
notes: Do not touch the PC while it runs (about 40 min). Every arm sits on the title/attract loop, which the game reaches with no input. The runner keeps the display on (SetThreadExecutionState) until the matrix ends.

RUN-WINDOW3.cmd runs -Only d0,base,d11,n0 (Agent 1 priority; d12 is dropped to fit 45 min with 4 reps). Order: one unscored cold run per bin (devoff2, baseline, native2), then 4 rounds, rotated each round.
Window: 5 s settle + 35 s warm-up from the first frame (past the ~33 s intro-to-title step), then 50 s measured.

Primary metric: uncapped frame rate. OFF arms pass framerate_limit=0 (Agent 3 section 3.1: the only cap on OFF builds); n0 also passes native_fps_limit=0 (gpu_native/device.cpp: 0 is uncapped; default 240). Secondary: drivers/thread-cpu.ps1 per run writes threads.csv and headroom.json (busiest thread busy %, headroom = 100 - that, total cores) and gpu.csv (NVML each second: GPU util, clocks, power/thermal throttle).

n0 passes native_settings_frontend=false: native builds crash at start with the frontend on ('Native setting is not registered: present_fsr_sharpness_reduction', FidelityFX-OFF SDK; Agents 6/7). Its frames come from LEGO_NATIVE_FRAME_METRICS (native-frames.csv).
d11 check: every d11 game.log must show 'Host timer resolution set to 1 ms (background opt-out on)'. No profiler on these arms.
Post-hoc: python bench/agent8/run/matrix_recheck.py <out dir> --write (paired deltas per round, headroom, foreign dumps).

arms.note: devoff2 (S2, batch 2) at defaults, uncapped: the reference
devoff2 + Agent 11 ON bundle (R3: timer 1 ms + opt-out, precise sleep, wait round-up, cs_spin, pause spin, lock-free clock, TLS bounds fix), uncapped
native2 N0 at defaults, uncapped (native_fps_limit=0), settings frontend off (crash workaround)
devoff2 + Agent 12 ON bundle (the five io/log cvars), uncapped; dropped from window 3 unless n0 fails
